description: Synthetic furnished office building with open-roof cutaway, workspace, meeting room, private office, lounge, reception and kitchenette. One-axis test robot; no captured real office data.

fidelity.geometry: Hand-authored 16 by 12 metre furnished office cutaway; native MJCF primitives and procedural materials, illustrative layout and collision geometry
fidelity.robot: One-axis test robot with visual mobile-base bodywork; original 1 kg sphere collision envelope and 0.016 kg m^2 diagonal inertia, ideal watchdog brake; not differential-drive or Go2 dynamics
fidelity.gas: analytic Gaussian field with seeded measurement noise; no fluid dynamics
fidelity.camera: camera-a fixed, camera-b robot-mounted; live MuJoCo RGB renders from copied physics state
fidelity.audio: generated 880 Hz mono test tone or quiet noise; no acoustic propagation

asset_license: Proprietary Wendy Labs fixture; no real office data

scenario.name: furnished-office-inspection
scenario.expected: operator task moves the robot and changes its camera and gas observations in the same physics scene
